newsitem.title: USA: Atlantic sets more Washington-NY flights.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic sets more Washington-NY flights.

text.p: Atlantic Coast Airlines Inc, which operates in eastern United States as United Express, said Wednesday it will increase its non-stop service between Washington-Dulles International Airport and New York's La Guardia Airport, effective May 15.
It said United Express will add two roundtrip flights daily between the two airports, raising its daily roundtrip flights to seven.
Atlantic Coast operates its hub at the Washington-Dulles airport, where it offers nearly 200 departures every business day, serving 38 cities in 17 states.
